verdict.rationale: SerpApi supports an `md` output format that returns markdown-formatted search results optimized for LLMs/AI agents, and a dedicated markdown-output feature serving any search result as clean markdown, plus raw HTML output — but this is markdown/HTML of the SERP results themselves, not full page text extraction of the underlying linked pages. missing for 10: evidence of extracting full text/markdown of the destination web pages (not just search result snippets/HTML/markdown), and independent hands-on verification of markdown output quality.
